investigation_notes.Description: A registry Run entry was created to launch powershell.exe with ExecutionPolicy Bypass and a hidden window to execute C:\ProgramData\winupd.ps1, indicating an attempt to establish persistence. The use of execution policy bypass, hidden execution, and a non-standard 'winupd.ps1' file name on a Windows Server host is consistent with malicious behavior. These indicators elevate risk and warrant immediate follow-up to confirm ownership of the file, the legitimacy of the account, and potential lateral or persistent activity.
